entries.notes: WF-RUST-099 is closed at the production Rust replay boundary. The TypeScript characterization remains green and deliberately proves the legacy cache aliases conflicting workflow-run and event payload bytes to the first preparation. Production Rust binds each logical cache key to the exact original binary bytes. Reusing a run or event key with different bytes creates a terminal, redacted PayloadConflict, does not invoke the preparer for the conflicting payload, wakes in-flight waiters, and cannot be overwritten when the original preparation later completes. The permanent Rust core workflow requires the TypeScript characterization and both production Rust replay-cache test targets to pass.
